notes.seen: scan, native 1272x1837 (IIIF https://archiviodistatofirenze.cultura.gov.it/iipsrv/iipsrv.fcgi?IIIF=/data/iip-data/asfi/mediceo_avanti_principato/00100089/A0000463.ptif and A0000464), zoomed in four 2200-px bands: recto about 45 lines of letter-like symbol cipher (x, ‡, H, =, 5, 6, 4, 8 forms) with clear words between runs (e.g. "quanto", "conforto", "Bisognerà", "mille", "potrò"); head "+ ... di gennaio 1478"; no interlinear, marginal or foot decipherment anywhere; verso blank except the endorsement "1478 adì 16 di gennaio / da G. Mazinghi" and "Cifra". Neighbours 89/141 (a list of Florentine names) and 89/143 (a clear letter) carry no decipherment. Inventory vol. 3 lists it under "A Lorenzo di Piero di Cosimo Medici".

Tomokiyo: cryptiana italian.htm Florence section lists only Lasry's Siena no. 11 (Acciaiuoli to Lorenzo, Rome 13 Jun 1478, R4800) and the Gabbrielli 1425 cipher; no MAP letter. Lasry: GL.htm (targets/gramont1529) has no Florentine item; his Siena 2308 report covers R4800 only. Literature: Marco Vito, HistoCrypt 2025 (a polyalphabetic key in Miscellanea repubblicana, recipient Piero Capponi) and his 1486-91 MAP project, outside 1478. Google Books feed "Giovanni Mazzinghi" 1478 finds only the MAP inventory entry. Identity of Giovanni Mazzinghi not established (the Lettere 1488 volume and a 1982 Giornale italiano di filologia note name other Mazzinghi; the Giornale's Giovanni Mazzinghi is a 16th-century agent).
notes.key: MAP LXXII 170 (lead 2308, 23 Jan 1478) carries the same sign set with a full interlinear decipherment: the key is rebuildable from it; not tested here. Lasry's Siena no. 11 key (1478) is a different sign set.
